role: shared ingredient shelf and cocktail availability inventory
known_patches: The collected shelf-add route inserts absent BarIngredient pairs; the release spec incorrectly used update. The base spec uses create with the real (bar_id, ingredient_id) unique key.
Only one ingredient_id is accepted per tool call; the unused legacy ingredients list was removed from the input schema.
Ingredient.index is a bar-scoped list endpoint; the release keyword ranking returned zero rows without a query. The base spec lists bar ingredients directly.
